vatModeHints.None: No VAT is charged or shown on bills
vatModeHints.Inclusive: Customers pay the shelf price; the VAT is worked out of what they pay
vatModeHints.Exclusive: VAT is added to the item prices after discounts

settings.vatNotice: A change here applies to new bills only; existing bills keep their amounts. Please confirm with the shop's accountant whether the shop must register for VAT. The system does not issue tax invoices yet.
settings.pointsExample: A purchase of 1,000 baht earns {{points}} points
settings.pointsRules: A customer earns points when their name is chosen at the till, on what they actually pay after discounts and points used. A part of a point is not given. A discount from points comes off before VAT, needs the till to be online, and must leave something to pay. When a bill is cancelled, the points it gave are taken back and the points used on it are returned.
settings.pointValueOff: 0 = points cannot be used as a discount
